_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your API key. config.json is ignored by git/zip for security.

_provider_options.mock: Uses frontend built-in mock engine (default, offline)
_provider_options.openai-compatible: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenAI, DeepSeek, local vLLM, etc.)

_usage: Set provider to one of the options above, fill in base_url/api_key/model, then restart the backend.
